# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 0.7.1 - 2026-11-05

- First version: Prefect remote MCP server over streamable HTTP.
- Endpoint taken from the Claude connector directory listing for Prefect.
- The auth mode is OAuth. The server answered an anonymous request with a 401 and OAuth metadata. BoldCreate Connect supplies its own OAuth client.
